By signing Senate Bill 175 on Thursday, they are erecting deliberate bureaucratic barriers that disproportionately target marginalized groups, new registrants, and working-class people who are just trying to make their voices heard in state elections. 

They try to hide behind bureaucratic double-speak in their press release, claiming it "only appl[y] to state elections and only impacts new registrants," but make no mistake: this is part of a systemic, historical effort to restrict access to the ballot box and protect entrenched power structures at the expense of ordinary citizens. We need urgent institutional reform to stop these relentless assaults on our democracy and to guarantee that every single person has an unhindered right to vote.
